subject: Onboarding gateway playbook & activation timeline
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sam Skelly <sam@edgehealth.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding gateway playbook & activation timeline

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I put together a short "gateway onboarding playbook" that maps our mutual action plan (MAP) items to concrete owners and a compressed activation sprint so you can validate performance in your staging cluster before commit. The goal here is to get a working POC environment with live API keys and network connectivity within two weeks so your app team can run load/latency checks before contract close.

High-level checklist (we can convert to a shared MAP doc):
- Redwood: create EdgeHealth org in Console & invite initial admins (API key owner) — due Dec 3 — owner: Priya
- EdgeHealth: provide list of egress IPs for allowlist + VPC peering CIDR — due Dec 4 — owner: Sam/IT
- Redwood: provision short-lived API key for staging, scoped to model_evaluation role — due Dec 6 — owner: Marcus
- EdgeHealth: approve VPC peering template & route/ASN details — due Dec 7 — owner: EdgeHealth IT
- Joint: smoke test (auth, model inference, KV cache) on staging — target window Dec 8–9

Attachments included: vpc-peering-template.txt (template for peering), ip-allowlist.csv (CSV stub for IPs). I also attached a compact checklist PDF to use in your procurement packet.

Open questions I flagged for the MAP:
1) Do you want the staging API key to be issued to a service account or to an individual admin? We recommend a service account for CI/CD.
2) Any additional network constraints (egress NAT, proxies) that might interfere with peering?

If that timeline looks feasible I will: create the org, send the invite, and provision the peering template as a Doc we can co-edit. Please confirm the people on your side who should receive the console invite (admin + billing).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if you prefer a live walk-through.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
[Attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt (text)]
[Attachment: ip-allowlist.csv (csv)]

-----
From: Sam Skelly <sam@edgehealth.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeHealth IT <it@edgehealth.io>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Onboarding gateway playbook & activation timeline

Priya —

Thanks, this looks actionable and the two-week target would be ideal. Two asks from my side before we lock dates: 1) Security team wants our SOC2 questionnaire answered; I attached a short set of controls they flagged (see attached edgehealth-soc2-questions.pdf). Can Redwood confirm support for data residency, log retention, and admin audit exports? 2) Can we compress the API key issuance to Dec 4 instead of Dec 6? Our dev sprint starts Dec 6 and we want keys by then.

I will send over the initial IP list by end of day. Also, please send the invite to me (sam@edgehealth.io) and our platform lead (tara.kim@edgehealth.io).

Sam
Director of Platform, EdgeHealth
[Attachment: edgehealth-soc2-questions.pdf (pdf)]

-----
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sam Skelly <sam@edgehealth.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding gateway playbook & activation timeline

Sam —

Appreciate the quick reply and the SOC2 packet. Quick responses inline:
- Data residency: our hosted tenants use regional routing; for MAP/POC we can pin traffic to us-west-2 and provide logs export (S3) for your retention requirements.
- Log retention/audit exports: we can provide admin audit logs for the POC window; we'll coordinate exact export cadence once you confirm retention duration.

We can accelerate API key issuance to Dec 4 if EdgeHealth can confirm the service account email (recommended) or who will accept the console invite by Dec 3. New proposed timeline (condensed):
- Dec 1: EdgeHealth sends IP allowlist + confirm service account email (Sam/Tara) — action: EdgeHealth
- Dec 2: Redwood creates EdgeHealth org & invites admin(s) — action: Priya
- Dec 3: Redwood prepares VPC peering config (draft sent to EdgeHealth) — action: Marcus
- Dec 4: API key issued for staging (scoped) + initial smoke-test instructions — action: Marcus / Laura
- Dec 6–7: Joint smoke tests and perf runs; capture latency and token throughput metrics — action: joint
- Dec 8: Readout & close decision (move to procurement / commit)

Action items I will take now: create the org and send invites to the two emails you specified once you confirm them; Marcus will draft the peering/route info and ping your network team directly. Laura will produce a short test runner checklist (auth, inference, KV cache, token-cost reporting).

If you want, I can also add these rows to our shared MAP spreadsheet and send a Doc link — would you prefer a Google Sheet or a Doc?

Best,
Priya
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Sam Skelly <sam@edgehealth.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding gateway playbook & activation timeline

Looping in for network/ops notes. Quick notes and owners from my side: 
- I will send the VPC peering template to EdgeHealth IT today (vpc-peering-template.txt) with suggested route table entries and a one-click BGP snippet. Please confirm your peering CIDR and preferred ASN.
- For API key issuance: Marcus will create a scoped staging key (rotatable) and post it into the Console invite as a "staging credential" with an expiration of 30 days. Laura will follow with the smoke-test checklist by EOD.
- Security answers: I will coordinate the SOC2 questions with our security team and return a control-level response by Dec 3. If there are any controls that require longer legal review we will flag them in the MAP.

Next steps: Priya will send the org invite once Sam confirms Tara's email. Marcus to send peering template (today). Laura to deliver smoke-test checklist (EOD). I'll create a calendar block for Dec 4 at 10:00 PT for the staging key handoff and initial smoke test.

Thanks — happy to join the call.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt (text)]
